hero.title: UPLOAD → FIND → DECIDE
hero.lead: maulwurf turns your class recordings into searchable text with exact citations.
hero.sub: so you never lose what the teacher said or the deadlines they mentioned, without keeping the audio.

upload.title: upload without keeping audio
upload.desc: the audio lives only in RAM while it is transcribed.

find.title: find it with real citations
find.desc: every answer cites a verified segment.

decide.title: decide before anything is written
decide.desc: nothing reaches calendar or gmail without your confirmation.

points.ram: ephemeral audio in RAM only (bounded, non-executable tmpfs).
points.absence: strict verification that temporary audio is gone before indexing text.
points.tenancy: multitenant isolation through forced RLS in PostgreSQL 16.
points.cache: local browser cache and service worker limited to the static shell.

recording.q: is my recording kept, or is there a player?
recording.a: no. The audio only lives in temporary memory while it is transcribed and never reaches disk, S3 or the browser.

writes.q: does maulwurf create events or send emails on its own?
writes.a: never. Every task goes into review and is only written to Google Calendar once you confirm it; Gmail requires opt-in and explicit permission.

deletion.q: can i delete all my data?
deletion.a: yes. From Settings you can start the observable deletion of your account, transcripts, embeddings and tasks.

footer.privacy: audio not kept · only encrypted text persisted
